agent_explanation: Controller force limit bypassed by seeded sensor noise applied after clamping. With kp*vcmd >> fmax the base command saturates at fmax (64.18), but noise factor ~1.30 scales it to 83.44 exceeding fmax. Raising fmax preserves ratio (117/90=1.30, 260/200=1.30) showing noise multiplies after the limit. Setting noise to 0 removes scaling and keeps force within limit.
